metaDescription: Kevin's first livestream uses the Webb AI research tool to examine 12 dead or missing US scientists tied to UAP, aerospace and nuclear programs.
summary: Kevin uses the Webb document-research tool in his first livestream to investigate a cluster of 12 US scientists and officials with ties to classified aerospace, nuclear and UAP programs who died or vanished between 2022 and 2026. He lists the cases, including Amy Eskridge and Major General William Neil McCasland, and reports that Webb links seven of them to the Air Force Research Laboratory. Kevin also reviews skeptical arguments about mortality rates and cherry-picking, and says he suspects a conspiracy but admits the cause is unknown. He presents the cluster as unproven and open to investigation.
